answers.rationale: This requirement specifies the environment for the switchgear house, which is provided by others. It does not directly pertain to a product from the catalog.
The requirement specifies indoor metal-clad switchgear with drawout vacuum circuit breakers, which matches the description of the CROWN-ARMV product in the catalog.
The number of independent trip coils is a specification for the switchgear, which aligns with the CROWN-ARMV product.
The current transformer specifications, including relaying ratio, accuracy, and thermal rating, are part of the switchgear configuration, which matches the CROWN-ARMV product.
